cases.setup: Encode WB-OPEN-EMPTY-FINAL-GROUP
cases.assertion: Bytes equal `27 01 02 03 04 00 00 00 00` exactly.

cases.setup: Encode WB-OPEN-DEFAULTED-AND-OMITTED
cases.assertion: Bytes equal the 52-byte vector in WORKED_BYTES.md exactly, including fixed little-endian u16 coordinates.

cases.setup: Encode WB-APPLY-ONE-EXPLICIT
Encode FinishStream Complete
cases.assertion: Bytes equal `28 0c 00`.

cases.setup: Encode FinishStream Fail(error=13)
cases.assertion: Bytes equal `28 0c 01 0d`.

cases.setup: Encode FinishStream Cancelled
cases.assertion: Bytes equal `28 0c 02`.

cases.setup: Encode one Explicit operand
cases.assertion: First operand byte is tag 0; payload is exactly the field order in EXACT_WIRE_TABLE.md.

cases.setup: Encode one Defaulted operand
cases.assertion: First operand byte is tag 1; payload is exactly the field order in EXACT_WIRE_TABLE.md.

cases.setup: Encode one OmittedOptional operand
cases.assertion: First operand byte is tag 2; payload is exactly the field order in EXACT_WIRE_TABLE.md.

cases.setup: Encode one RestPositional operand
cases.assertion: First operand byte is tag 3; payload is exactly the field order in EXACT_WIRE_TABLE.md.

cases.setup: Encode one RestNamed operand
cases.assertion: First operand byte is tag 4; payload is exactly the field order in EXACT_WIRE_TABLE.md.

cases.setup: Encode Complete producer outcome
cases.assertion: Outcome tag is exactly 0; only Fail carries one register ID.

cases.setup: Encode Fail producer outcome
cases.assertion: Outcome tag is exactly 1; only Fail carries one register ID.

cases.setup: Encode Cancelled producer outcome
cases.assertion: Outcome tag is exactly 2; only Fail carries one register ID.

cases.setup: For each of the six worked vectors decode, encode, decode, and encode again
cases.assertion: Both encodings are byte-identical and both decoded values are equal.

cases.setup: Change only AWBC codec version from 8 to 7
cases.assertion: Decoder rejects at header/version validation before reading any new table or instruction payload.

cases.setup: ABI 1 with codec 8
cases.assertion: Decoder rejects before payload tables; no compatibility mode.

cases.setup: Decode instruction byte 0x1c
cases.assertion: Unknown instruction opcode at the opcode byte.

cases.setup: Decode instruction byte 0x1d
cases.assertion: Unknown instruction opcode at the opcode byte.

cases.setup: Decode instruction byte 0x1e
cases.assertion: Unknown instruction opcode at the opcode byte.

cases.setup: Decode instruction byte 0x20
cases.assertion: Unknown instruction opcode at the opcode byte.

cases.setup: Decode a valid current-main CallTraitMethod record beginning with 0x22
cases.assertion: It remains CallTraitMethod; it is not rejected or reinterpreted.

cases.setup: Decode a valid current-main RegisterCleanup record beginning with 0x23
cases.assertion: It remains RegisterCleanup; it is not rejected or reinterpreted.

cases.setup: Decode instruction byte 0x2a
cases.assertion: Unknown instruction opcode; 0x2a is unassigned, not an implicit reserved instruction.

cases.setup: Decode parent flat Open bytes `27 02 03 02 00 04 01` as a codec-8 instruction
cases.assertion: It cannot become an accepted OpenStream; decoding or verification rejects the incomplete group-aware payload.

cases.setup: Use opcode 0x27 with a syntactically group-aware payload whose group is non-final
cases.assertion: It decodes only as OpenStream and verifier rejects non-final Open; there is no Apply alias.

cases.setup: Use opcode 0x28 followed by child Open fields with callee byte 0x08
cases.assertion: It decodes only as FinishStream and rejects outcome tag 0x08; there is no Open alias.

cases.setup: Coordinate vector length differs from operand vector length
cases.assertion: Decoder/verifier rejects without zipping, sorting, or repairing vectors.

cases.setup: Coordinates are duplicated or out of order
cases.assertion: Verifier rejects exact malformed order; encoder never canonicalizes it into validity.

cases.setup: Encode group/parameter coordinate 1
cases.assertion: Each u16 is exactly two little-endian bytes `01 00`, not varint.

cases.setup: Encode register/table ID 300
cases.assertion: ID is canonical u32 varint `ac 02`; noncanonical forms reject.

cases.setup: ApplyExternalStreamGroup targets final group
cases.assertion: Reject before execution: Apply requires group+1 < group_count.

cases.setup: OpenStream targets non-final group
cases.assertion: Reject before execution: Open requires group+1 == group_count.

cases.setup: FinishStream appears in Ordinary function
cases.assertion: Reject: owning function must be GeneratorProducer with OWNS_STREAM_PRODUCER.

cases.setup: FinishStream appears in GeneratorProducer lacking MAY_SUSPEND
cases.assertion: Reject before execution.

cases.setup: FinishStream appears in GeneratorProducer lacking OWNS_STREAM_PRODUCER
cases.assertion: Reject before execution.

cases.setup: Current fiber producer_stream key/lease does not reciprocally match table producer owner
cases.assertion: Typed runtime trap/rejection before terminal mutation.

cases.setup: Finish stream register key differs from FiberState.producer_stream.key
cases.assertion: Reject without terminalizing either stream.

cases.setup: Apply/Open definition table index is out of bounds
cases.assertion: Reject before register or operand checks.

cases.setup: Apply/Open definition has authored or derived origin
cases.assertion: Reject; the group-application instructions are external-origin only.

cases.setup: Signature ID is not exactly the definition-owned callable signature
cases.assertion: Reject SignatureMismatch.

cases.setup: Callee static type has wrong definition
cases.assertion: Reject before execution.

cases.setup: Callee next_group differs from instruction group
cases.assertion: Reject before execution.

cases.setup: Apply destination is not ExternalStreamCallable(definition, group+1)
cases.assertion: Reject before execution.

cases.setup: Open destination is not matching StreamHandle(item,error)
cases.assertion: Reject before execution.

cases.setup: Coordinate list omits one parameter in the group
cases.assertion: Reject MissingCoordinate.

cases.setup: Coordinate list includes a coordinate from another group
cases.assertion: Reject UnknownCoordinate.

cases.setup: Required non-rest parameter uses OmittedOptional
cases.assertion: Reject IllegalDisposition.

cases.setup: Optional parameter uses Defaulted
cases.assertion: Reject IllegalDisposition.

cases.setup: Defaulted digest differs from parameter metadata
cases.assertion: Reject DefaultFingerprintMismatch.

cases.setup: Explicit operand register has wrong type
cases.assertion: Reject TypeMismatch.

cases.setup: RestPositional register is not Sequence<parameter.ty>
cases.assertion: Reject malformed rest aggregate.

cases.setup: RestNamed register is not Sequence<Tuple<String, parameter.ty>>
cases.assertion: Reject malformed named-rest aggregate.

cases.setup: FinishStream Fail register has wrong definition error type
cases.assertion: Reject before execution.

cases.setup: FinishStream follows an earlier terminal Finish in the same reachable producer path
cases.assertion: Reject single-terminal ownership violation.

cases.setup: One callable group with zero parameters
cases.assertion: Accepted; group remains explicit and completed_groups advances from 0 to 1.

cases.setup: Exactly 16 groups and 128 total parameters
cases.assertion: Accepted when every coordinate is contiguous and all other invariants hold.

cases.setup: 17 groups
cases.assertion: Reject before allocation with group limit exceeded.

cases.setup: 129 total parameters
cases.assertion: Reject before allocation with parameter limit exceeded.

cases.setup: One group with exactly 128 parameters
cases.assertion: Accepted.

cases.setup: One group with 129 parameters
cases.assertion: Reject before allocating argument cells.

cases.setup: Apply/Open an empty declared group with empty coordinate/value vectors
cases.assertion: Accepted when group role is otherwise valid; empty group is not inferred from product length.

cases.setup: Complete product contains exactly 128 cells
cases.assertion: Accepted.

cases.setup: Product contains 129 cells
cases.assertion: Reject without mutating partial, instance table, or request batch.

cases.setup: Call a two-group external Stream directly in one source expression and via saved intermediate partial
cases.assertion: Final canonical product bytes and signature/argument fingerprints are equal.

cases.setup: Call a three-group external Stream direct versus staged across suspension/save points
cases.assertion: Coordinates, dispositions, digests, completed_groups, and open request are equal.

cases.setup: Apply first group of a multi-group external Stream
cases.assertion: Produces only ExternalStreamPartial(next_group=1); allocates no instance and emits no request.

cases.setup: Apply a middle group
cases.assertion: Joins exactly one canonical group, advances once, and emits no request.

cases.setup: Apply final group after valid prefix
cases.assertion: Validates full product, allocates one ordinal/key, inserts one Opening entry, yields one handle, emits one Open request atomically.

cases.setup: Final group value/type/default/generation validation fails
cases.assertion: No ordinal, lease, request ID, instance entry, handle, or request batch mutation is observable.

cases.setup: Earlier authored group has effectful argument/default
cases.assertion: It executes once when that group is applied and is never replayed at final Open.

cases.setup: Captured product contains an affine value
cases.assertion: ExternalStreamPartial is affine and cannot be duplicated by ordinary closure cloning.

cases.setup: Load external callable constant, partially apply, save, restore, and apply again
cases.assertion: Every phase uses RuntimeFunctionValue::ExternalStreamPartial; no parallel function-value representation appears.

cases.setup: Correct producer executes FinishStream Complete in structured runtime, AWBC VM, and compiled region
cases.assertion: All paths commit End exactly once and later NextStream yields Closed(End).

cases.setup: Correct producer executes FinishStream Fail(error)
cases.assertion: All paths commit TerminalError payload exactly once; later NextStream yields Closed(Error).

cases.setup: Correct producer executes FinishStream Cancelled
cases.assertion: All paths commit Cancelled exactly once; later NextStream yields Closed(Cancelled).

cases.setup: A different fiber tries to finish the instance
cases.assertion: Reject without terminal mutation in structured runtime, VM, and compiled region.

cases.setup: Build sorted stream_definitions table
cases.assertion: RuntimeStreamDefinitionId equals table index; RuntimeStreamDefinitionKey survives encode/decode unchanged.

cases.setup: Lower RuntimePlan definition to AwbcStreamDefinition
cases.assertion: AwbcStreamDefinitionId is the table index and semantic_key is the exact RuntimeStreamDefinitionKey bytes.

cases.setup: Package and load the codec-8 AWBC payload
cases.assertion: Definition index/key mapping is unchanged; bundle contains no fabricated live instance key.

cases.setup: Open definition key K in generation G at ordinal O
cases.assertion: Only StreamInstanceKey { definition_key: K, generation: G, ordinal: O } is the complete live identity.

cases.setup: Serialize and deserialize RuntimeStreamRequest::Open
cases.assertion: The complete StreamInstanceKey and RuntimeStreamDefinitionKey round-trip exactly; no bare ordinal field exists.

cases.setup: Save a live/restorable Stream instance and external partial
cases.assertion: Definition key, generation, ordinal, declaration, signature fingerprint, group progress, coordinates, and dispositions survive exactly.

cases.setup: Restore against the same bundle and generation set
cases.assertion: Reconstructed StreamInstanceKey equals the saved key and binds to the loaded definition key/index.

cases.setup: Saved instance definition key is absent or mapped to different loaded definition
cases.assertion: Restore rejects before installing candidate state.

cases.setup: Saved generation or ordinal is altered
cases.assertion: Restore rejects; it never substitutes a current generation or allocates a replacement ordinal.

cases.setup: Inspect RuntimePlan, AWBC, and bundle data models
cases.assertion: They carry definition ID/key only; live StreamInstanceKey begins at runtime allocation and is not added to static formats.

cases.setup: Compute two definitions with identical flattened parameters but different group boundaries/coordinates
cases.assertion: RuntimeStreamDefinitionKey values differ; the old flat 394-byte/06c9... golden is not accepted.

cases.setup: Encode one final grouped definition-key fixture using the exact nested transcript
cases.assertion: Implementation records exact transcript bytes and BLAKE3-256 golden and round-trips the same key through RuntimePlan/AWBC/bundle.
